title: BSW.DevSpark Knowledge Entity Node (_entity.yaml)
description: Domain-entity node under .knowledge/entities/<id>/_entity.yaml. Declares the entity's identity, owner, relations to other entities, and any justified coverage overrides for missing layer documents.

id.description: Must match the parent folder name under .knowledge/entities/.

type.description: Domain-entity classification (e.g. service, workflow, integration) — distinct from doc-level `layer`.

owner.description: Team or role accountable for keeping this entity's layer docs current.

constrained_by.description: Lightweight pointer to .knowledge/governance/decisions/<id>.md docs that constrain this entity. Each id must also list this entity in its `constrains` array — the decision owns the reasoning, this is only a pointer.
